invariant: GC must never delete snapshot-reachable or current-live data.
current_evidence: GC package baseline is strong; maintenance orchestration is lower visibility but already tracked as Tier 1.
future_gap: Map maintenance orchestration paths in future coverage hardening; do not add broad tests in Phase 4.

invariant: Restore must be deterministic and must reconstruct the intended bytes and paths.
current_evidence: Storage and block coverage are visible; restore path is critical and broad; deterministic restore evidence exists but should remain explicitly mapped.
future_gap: Future hardening should focus on stored-path modes, overwrite behavior, packed/legacy restore parity, and interrupted restore evidence.

invariant: Verify must fail closed on corrupted or inconsistent catalog/storage state.
current_evidence: Verify has moderate baseline coverage and existing corruption-path evidence.
future_gap: Future work should map individual corruption classes to tests rather than chasing raw coverage.

invariant: Recovery must not legitimize corrupt mappings or ambiguous physical state.
current_evidence: Recovery is low-visibility Tier 1 baseline and should be treated as future hardening priority.
future_gap: Future work should add invariant-focused recovery coverage for quarantine, orphan containers, stale metadata, and interrupted operations.

invariant: Snapshots must remain immutable roots for restore and retention.
current_evidence: Snapshot and supporting graph/retention packages have strong baseline coverage.
future_gap: Future work should preserve current evidence and avoid regressions.

invariant: Packed and legacy storage behavior must remain semantically aligned.
current_evidence: Packed/legacy evidence is present across storage, blocks, verify, and container packages.
future_gap: Future work should map packed-only, legacy-only, and mixed-repository cases explicitly.

invariant: Reclaim/rebuild must not reuse stale or inconsistent physical metadata.
current_evidence: v1.10.6 introduced a narrow CI-blocker fix and regression evidence for stale metadata cleanup.
future_gap: Future work should keep this invariant represented in coverage and adversarial CI.

invariant: Catalog schema, migration, and capability detection must preserve semantics across supported backends.
current_evidence: Catalog compatibility has visible baseline coverage and is central to SQLite/PostgreSQL compatibility.
future_gap: Future work should connect this to dual-backend coverage gates after v1.10.7.

invariant: Container reads/writes must preserve payload integrity and placement bounds.
current_evidence: Container coverage is moderate and supports restore/verify correctness.
future_gap: Future work should map encrypted/compressed placement, header rejection, offset bounds, and short-read cases.

invariant: Retention policy must preserve required snapshots and roots.
current_evidence: Retention has strong baseline coverage through direct and supporting packages.
future_gap: Future work should ensure policy decisions remain aligned with snapshot delete and GC planning.

invariant: CLI and JSON contracts must remain stable where automation depends on them.
current_evidence: CLI/JSON remains observe-only in v1.10.7 to avoid turning this into a CLI cleanup release.
future_gap: Future work may add targeted contract coverage if tied to automation correctness.

invariant: Benchmark and release artifacts should remain deterministic and schema-valid.
current_evidence: Benchmark/reporting concerns remain visible but not release-blocking in v1.10.7.
future_gap: Future cleanup should be separate unless required by coverage tooling.
